name: When should I get a professional roof inspection report?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a professional roof inspection report?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should get a professional roof inspection report after severe weather, before buying or selling a home, or if you notice any signs of damage like leaks or missing shingles. It's also wise to schedule inspections every 1-3 years for general maintenance, especially for older roofs. Regular inspections can help identify minor issues before they become costly major repairs, extending your roof's life.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get a professional roof inspection after severe weather, before buying/selling a home, or if you notice damage. Regular checks every 1-3 years are also recommended.
